X Takeover: Well, I think Nicki Minaj just took over the takeover. 😂🩷

The Tesla community is absolutely losing it today over Nicki announcing she’ll be at X Takeover at Giga Texas.

The Barbz are coming. The hot pink Teslas are coming. And somewhere, a bunch of Tesla fam are probably detailing their cars as we speak. 🤣

What I love about this is that underneath all the technology, Tesla people are still car people.

They nerd out over their cars. They meet at Superchargers. They talk modifications. They take pictures of them. They name them. And when you buy one, you suddenly discover there’s this whole Tesla family you didn’t even know existed.

I haven’t made it to a Takeover yet. Mine came into my life a little too recently, and hauling the whole Mars Homestead across the country isn’t in the cards this year.

Maybe next year. 💛

But this one?

X Takeover may need to temporarily rename itself the Nicki Minaj Takeover. 😂🩷

Tesla fam, are we ready for the Barbz?
